zh-CN.title: 科研课题工作台
items: 导师可以布置任务、查看本期汇报提交情况，并从待办直接处理反馈和报销。
学生可以查看自己的任务期限，从待办提交汇报，或者回到上次未写完的草稿。
课题可直接创建。任务详情集中展示要求、资料和进展讨论。

en.title: Research workspaces
items: Mentors can assign work, see who has submitted the current report, and open feedback and reimbursement requests from their to-do list.
Students can see their deadlines, submit reports from their to-do list, and resume unfinished drafts.
Create a project in one step and find instructions, files, and discussions on each task.
